title: Sunday · the pup in February
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The pup on the beach in February, fourteen months, in the strip's first Sunday with him: the run, the two-one prints, the drift log he can't climb yet. The dog Sunday, resumed with a new dog.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the February beach, gray, and the small three-legged dog running the tideline at full scuttle, his prints two-one behind him.

image.prompt: a gray February beach with a small three-legged dog running along the tideline leaving prints in a two-one rhythm, wet-on-wet watercolor, no words

panels.name: Run

panels.composition: Tier 2: the pup at the drift log, front paws up on it, not able to climb it yet. Looking up.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog with its front paws up on a bleached drift log looking up at the top it cannot reach, no words

panels.name: Log

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sea, the pup a dot at the water. Held.

image.prompt: a gray sea with a tiny dog at the water's edge, no words

panels.name: Sea

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The first dog Sunday with the pup. The log he can't climb yet.
